poiSection.modificationStatement: Gridly uses modified Overture Maps Places data. Gridly transforms, filters, normalizes, classifies, deduplicates and projects source POI records into its Texas-focused POI dataset.
poiSection.censusAcknowledgement: U.S. Census Bureau geography supports Texas, county, and community governance context; the Census Bureau does not supply POI records in this authority.
poiSection.osmStatement: OpenStreetMap is not merged into this POI authority and no OSM supplement is part of this release.
poiSection.nonAffiliationStatement: Business names and trademarks are the property of their respective owners. Their appearance in Gridly does not imply affiliation with or endorsement of Gridly.
